description:
Set voiceover text and/or generate speech for many clips in ONE call. Per entry: "set_text" (clip_index + text), "generate_speech" (async TTS; wait: true blocks until it lands), "set_and_generate" (both). Entries apply in order, one result each; all text lands in one save, TTS runs async per clip after.

- Address by clip_index, or clip_id (survives inserts/reorders); never both needed.
- Text: [emotion] tags are performed, not spoken; use sparingly before the phrase they colour. <pause:1.5s> = exact silence (also as a lead-in or hold; get_clip's voiceover_text shows existing pauses: keep them). The [pause] tag is a performed beat of no set length.
- Sizing: ~2–2.5 words/s; then read real durations back (get_clip once `busy` is empty) before timing visuals.
- Sync points: if the clip's voiceover_text has `<SYNC_MARKER N>` tokens (a recording's on-screen actions), new text must keep every one, once each, in order, where that action is narrated; else the entry is refused. Rephrase between them freely.
- Generating speech RESCALES the clip: duration becomes the audio length and EVERY element's start_time, end_time and keyframe timestamps are multiplied by new ÷ old (6s → 1.02s turns [0, 1.6] into [0, 0.27]); zooms that fall under the minimum are DROPPED. It lands after this call returns. So generate speech BEFORE placing timed elements, then re-read what your elements became.

Concurrency: parallel-safe per clip voiceover (fan out by clip; safe alongside element edits). The same clip's voiceover twice concurrently → the later is REJECTED, nothing written: re-read and re-apply. Not concurrently with whole-clip/project writes (update_clips on that clip, structural clip ops, add_audio, update_project).

action.description: Write the voiceover transcript onto the clip without generating audio.

clip_id.description: Clip ID. Give this or clip_index.

clip_index.description: Zero-based clip index. Give this or clip_id.

text.description: Voiceover transcript. Emotion and audio tags in square brackets ([excited], [whispers], [laughs]) are performed, not spoken. <pause:1.5s> is exact timed silence, allowed at the very start (a lead-in) and end (a hold).

action.description: Generate speech audio from the transcript already set on the clip.

clip_id.description: Clip ID. Give this or clip_index.

clip_index.description: Zero-based clip index. Give this or clip_id.

language.description: Language of this clip's speech, e.g. 'de' (default 'en').

action.description: Write the transcript and generate its speech audio in one step.

clip_id.description: Clip ID. Give this or clip_index.

clip_index.description: Zero-based clip index. Give this or clip_id.

language.description: Language of this clip's speech, e.g. 'de' (default 'en').

text.description: Voiceover transcript. Emotion and audio tags in square brackets ([excited], [whispers], [laughs]) are performed, not spoken. <pause:1.5s> is exact timed silence, allowed at the very start (a lead-in) and end (a hold).

wait.description: true: block until this call's speech lands so durations, voiceover_words and element times read next are real (`ready`: each clip's new duration). Bounded by wait_seconds; the rest come back as durations_pending (poll get_clip(select:['busy'])). Use whenever the next step times to the voiceover. In run_script it counts against the script's time.

wait_seconds.description: With wait: the most to wait, default 50s.
